product_units.name: Authentication & Authorization
product_units.purpose: Secure access control and identity verification.
product_units.user_problem: Need to securely authenticate and authorize access to app features
product_units.ai: None directly, but uses backend fraud detection models
notifications: Triggers auth success/failure emails and in-app alerts
product_units.current_status: Implemented, with known security patches applied (GLOW-SEC-02)
technical_debt: Legacy token handling in shared preferences; migration to encrypted storage completed
known_gaps: Session revocation on password change not fully propagated

product_units.name: User Profile & Settings
product_units.purpose: Centralize user identity, preferences, and consent management.
product_units.user_problem: Need to view, edit, and control personal data and app behavior
product_units.rag: Retrieves FAQ articles based on user queries
notifications: Triggers when profile updated or consent required
product_units.current_status: Partially implemented; some settings fragmented across legacy theme
technical_debt: Duplicated settings logic in shared/theme.dart and provider-specific screens

product_units.name: Provider Management
product_units.purpose: Enable providers to manage their presence, services, bookings, and earnings.
product_units.user_problem: Need a dashboard to showcase services, manage appointments, and track income
product_units.ai: Recommends providers to clients based on location, rating, service match
product_units.rag: Uses provider corpus to answer client queries about services
product_units.current_status: Implemented; dashboard screen complex, needs performance optimization
technical_debt: Large provider dashboard screen (>100k lines), monolithic state
known_gaps: Calendar sync with external calendars (Google/Apple) missing

product_units.name: Booking & Appointments
product_units.purpose: Facilitate service discovery, scheduling, and confirmation between clients and providers.
product_units.user_problem: Need to find, book, and manage beauty appointments seamlessly
product_units.ai: Suggests optimal time slots, predicts no-show likelihood
product_units.rag: Uses booking history to recommend recurring services
product_units.current_status: Core flow implemented; recovery and rescheduling features need refinement
technical_debt: Booking state scattered across multiple providers
Duplicate validation logic
known_gaps: No waitlist for fully booked slots

product_units.name: Payments & Wallet
product_units.purpose: Process payments securely and manage user funds and rewards.
product_units.primary_user: All users making purchases or receiving payouts
product_units.user_problem: Need to pay for services/products securely and earn rewards for loyalty
product_units.rag: Recommends payment methods based on user history
product_units.current_status: Wompi integration implemented; wallet feature present but not fully utilized across all payment contexts
technical_debt: Duplicate payment handling in booking and store flows
Lack of unified payment service abstraction
known_gaps: Limited payout methods for providers (only bank transfer)

product_units.name: Store & E-commerce
product_units.purpose: Sell beauty products directly to consumers.
secondary_users: Providers (who can sell products via consignment)
product_units.user_problem: Need to discover, evaluate, and purchase beauty products with confidence
product_units.ai: Product recommendation engine, visual search (via AURA), demand forecasting
product_units.rag: Uses product corpus to answer ingredient/questions
product_units.current_status: Store screen implemented; product detail missing AR/VU try-on (reliant on AURA VTO)
technical_debt: Product data denormalization
Missing unified image service (multiple image providers)

product_units.name: AURA Intelligence
product_units.purpose: Provide AI-driven beauty analysis, personalized recommendations, and virtual try-on.
product_units.user_problem: Need objective analysis of skin/hair condition and tailored product/service recommendations
product_units.ai: Core unit; uses multimodal models for skin analysis, hair simulation, color matching
product_units.rag: Retrieves from beauty knowledge corpus to explain analysis results
notifications: New recommendations based on updated data
product_units.current_status: MVP implemented; analysis latency high, VTO limited to nails and face overlay
technical_debt: Heavy use of image processing on UI thread
Models not quantized for web

product_units.name: Academy
product_units.purpose: Deliver educational content and certifications in beauty and wellness.
product_units.user_problem: Need accessible, structured learning to stay updated on beauty trends and techniques
product_units.ai: Recommends courses based on user role, interests, completion history
product_units.rag: Answers learner questions using course content
product_units.current_status: Course listing and viewing implemented; quiz engine basic, no timed exams
technical_debt: Video player not abstracted
Duplicated UI components across course types

product_units.name: Support & Ticketing
product_units.purpose: Assist users with issues, questions, and feedback.
product_units.user_problem: Need timely resolution of technical, billing, or service-related problems
product_units.ai: Suggests knowledge base articles, routes tickets to appropriate agent
product_units.rag: Powers FAQ search and automated responses
product_units.current_status: Ticket creation and chat implemented; no SLA automation, limited agent tools
technical_debt: Ticket chat lacks typing indicators, read receipts
Attachment size limits not enforced client-side
known_gaps: No in-app screen sharing for troubleshooting

product_units.name: Dispute Resolution
product_units.purpose: Mediate conflicts between users and providers regarding services or products.
product_units.primary_user: Clients who experienced issues with services/products
product_units.user_problem: Need a fair process to report problems and seek refunds or corrections
state: Dispute status (open, under review, resolved, rejected)
product_units.ai: Flags potentially fraudulent disputes, predicts resolution outcome
product_units.rag: Retrieves similar past disputes to inform mediation
product_units.current_status: Basic dispute filing implemented; no evidence validation, no automated escalation
technical_debt: Dispute logic duplicated in frontend and backend
No unified evidence viewer

product_units.name: Design & Personalization
product_units.purpose: Enable users to visualize and plan beauty routines, track progress, and customize looks.
product_units.primary_user: Clients interested in self-care routines and experimentation
product_units.user_problem: Need tools to plan outfits, track skin/hair changes, and virtually try products
product_units.ai: Generates outfit combinations, predicts evolution trends, validates medical suitability
product_units.rag: Uses personal care corpus to recommend routines
product_units.current_status: Screens implemented; data synchronization intermittent, no cloud backup for wardrobe
technical_debt: Heavy use of custom painters
Not optimized for low-end devices
known_gaps: Limited to female-centric wardrobe (male not differentiated)

product_units.name: Chat & Messaging
product_units.purpose: Enable real-time communication between users, providers, concierge, and support.
product_units.user_problem: Need to ask questions, get updates, and resolve issues without delays
product_units.ai: Suggests quick replies, translates messages, detects sentiment
product_units.rag: Retrieves from support knowledge to answer common queries
product_units.current_status: Basic chat implemented; no end-to-end encryption, message search limited
technical_debt: Message persistence relies on backend polling
No efficient diff sync

product_units.name: Location & Mapping
product_units.purpose: Provide geolocation, proximity search, and route calculation.
product_units.primary_user: Users seeking nearby providers or navigating to appointments
product_units.user_problem: Need to find beauty services close to me and get directions
product_units.ai: Predicts busy times, suggests optimal travel time
product_units.rag: Answers location-based queries ("Is there a salon open now near me?")
product_units.current_status: Map screen implemented; provider clustering missing, offline maps not supported
technical_debt: Geocoding calls not cached
Map state resets on tab switch

product_units.name: Notifications
product_units.purpose: Inform users of important events, updates, and opportunities.
product_units.user_problem: Need to stay informed about bookings, promotions, and app changes without opening the app constantly
product_units.ai: Optimizes send time, personalizes content, predicts churn
product_units.rag: Retrieves user history to tailor notification copy
upstream: Any feature generating an event (booking, payment, AURA analysis)
product_units.current_status: Basic push notifications implemented; no in-app notification center, limited rich media
technical_debt: Notification preferences not synced across devices
Duplicate Firebase initialization
known_gaps: No SMS fallback for undelivered push

product_units.name: Analytics & Metrics
product_units.purpose: Measure user behavior, business performance, and experiment outcomes.
product_units.user_problem: Need to understand what users do and why to improve the app
entry_points: Instrumented throughout app (screen views, button clicks, API calls)
product_units.ai: Detects anomalies, forecasts trends, suggests optimizations
notifications: Alert on metric threshold crossed (e.g., crash rate spike)
product_units.current_status: Analytics service implemented; event tracking incomplete (missing many UI interactions), no real-time dashboard
technical_debt: Inconsistent event naming
Client-side buffering unreliable on poor networks

product_units.name: Social Share
product_units.purpose: Allow users to share their beauty achievements, VTO, and content.
product_units.primary_user: Users proud of their results or seeking feedback
product_units.user_problem: Need to showcase beauty transformations and get social validation
product_units.ai: Suggests hashtags, detects NSFW content, recommends best time to post
product_units.rag: Retrieves trending beauty topics for share prompts
product_units.current_status: Basic sharing implemented; no deep linking, limited to image share (no video)
technical_debt: Share intents not handled gracefully on web
No persistent share history

product_boundaries.start: User submits credentials or initiates OAuth/biometric flow
product_boundaries.end: Session token issued and stored securely; user redirected to home
not_responsible_for: User profile edits (handled by Profile unit)

product_boundaries.start: User navigates to profile or settings screen
product_boundaries.end: Changes saved to backend and local preferences; confirmation shown

product_boundaries.start: Provider completes onboarding and logs in
product_boundaries.end: Provider can manage services, view appointments, and withdraw earnings

product_boundaries.start: User selects a service and provider
product_boundaries.end: Booking confirmed, payment initiated, user receives confirmation

product_boundaries.start: User confirms payment or initiates wallet top-up
product_boundaries.end: Transaction processed, balance updated, receipt issued

product_boundaries.start: User views product list or detail
product_boundaries.end: Order placed, payment initiated, user sees order confirmation

product_boundaries.start: User captures image or uploads media for analysis
product_boundaries.end: Analysis results displayed, recommendations shown, VTO available if applicable
not_responsible_for: Medical diagnosis (disclaimer: not a medical device)

product_boundaries.start: User browses or enrolls in a course
product_boundaries.end: User accesses lesson content, completes quiz, earns certificate/XP

product_boundaries.start: User submits a ticket or opens chat
product_boundaries.end: Agent responds, issue resolved or escalated, satisfaction survey sent

product_boundaries.start: User opens a dispute from a transaction or booking
product_boundaries.end: Dispute resolved, decision communicated, any refund processed

product_boundaries.start: User accesses a design tool (wardrobe, evolution, etc.)
product_boundaries.end: User receives suggestion, saves look, or tracks progress

product_boundaries.start: User opens a conversation or sends a message
product_boundaries.end: Message delivered, read receipt received, typing indicator shown

product_boundaries.start: User requests location or views map
product_boundaries.end: Nearby providers shown, route calculated, permissions handled

product_boundaries.start: An event triggers a notification (booking confirmed, promo)
product_boundaries.end: Notification delivered to user device, interaction logged
not_responsible_for: User opt-out legal compliance (handled by backend/legal)

product_boundaries.start: User interaction occurs (screen view, button click)
product_boundaries.end: Event logged, aggregated, made available for reporting

product_boundaries.start: User initiates share from content screen
product_boundaries.end: Content shared to selected platform, share log recorded
not_responsible_for: Content moderation beyond basic NSFW check

maturity.justification: Implemented, security patches applied, auth flows tested, token storage migrated to encrypted storage.
Core profile screens exist, but settings fragmented; validation pending for all fields.
Dashboard and provider screens functional; performance and completeness gaps.
Core flow works; recovery/rescheduling need refinement; validation incomplete.
Wompi integration done, wallet feature present; not fully utilized across all contexts.
Store screen and product listing work; detail missing AR/VU try-on; inventory sync gaps.
MVP implemented; analysis latency high, VTO limited; model validation and accuracy testing pending.
Course listing and viewing functional; quiz engine basic, no timed exams or certificates automation.
Ticket creation and chat work; SLA automation missing, agent tools limited.
Basic filing works; evidence validation, mediation timing, appeals missing.
Screens render; custom painters heavy, no cloud backup, limited male wardrobe.
Basic messaging works; no E2EE, message search limited, no voice/video.
Map and nearby search work; clustering, offline maps, indoor nav missing.
Push notifications functional; no in-app center, limited rich media, preferences not synced.
Event tracking implemented but incomplete; no real-time dashboard, funnel analysis missing.
Share dialog works; limited to images, no video, no deep linking or UGC feed.

risks: Duplicated logic: Payment handling duplicated in booking and store flows; validation rules scattered.
Tight coupling: Provider Management screen mixes UI, state, and networking; large file size risk.
Mixed responsibilities: AuthService handles token storage and API calls; should be separated.
Services without clear owner: NotificationService used by many units but lacks dedicated team ownership.
Data without owner: User preferences scattered across shared/theme.dart, SecureStorage, and backend; no single source of truth.
Incomplete features: Dispute resolution lacks evidence validation; AURA VTO limited to nails/face; Academy lacks certification automation.
Legacy code: Shared/theme.dart used in 40+ screens, duplicating tokens and colors.
Technical debt: Heavy custom painters, unoptimized image processing on UI thread, lack of model quantization.
Critical paths: Auth token expiration not handled gracefully in all screens; payment failure recovery inconsistent.
technical_debt: Large provider dashboard screen (>100k lines) needs refactoring into components.
Duplicate UI kits (LuxeCard vs CardTheme, LuxeButton vs ElevatedButtonTheme).
Hardcoded values in shared/theme.dart causing inconsistency with tokens.dart.
Image processing on main thread in AURA capture and analysis screens.
Lack of abstracted video player in Academy.
Notification service not using singleton pattern; multiple initializations observed.
Analytics event naming inconsistent; client-side buffering unreliable on poor networks.
Wallet service duplicated logic for booking and store payments.
Dispute evidence handling lacks standardized viewer and validation.
Provider management lacks pagination/infinite scroll for large service lists.
Academy course progress not synchronized across devices reliably.

priorities.rationale: Foundation for security and access; any breach impacts all users and trust.
Directly tied to revenue and compliance; failures cause financial loss and legal risk.
Core service delivery; impacts provider utilization and client satisfaction.
Revenue stream; affects inventory management and customer retention.
Differentiator; enables premium personalization and drives engagement/store sales.
Enables supply side; poor experience reduces provider retention and service quality.
Central to personalization and consent; gaps affect compliance and UX.
Affects churn and brand perception; critical for issue resolution.
Financial and legal risk; poor handling leads to chargebacks and reputational damage.
Drives engagement and product sales; incomplete features limit personalization value.
Enhances service but not core to primary flows; valued for convenience.
Improves discovery but alternatives exist (manual address entry).
Important for engagement but can be degraded gracefully.
Nice-to-have; contributes to brand authority but not core revenue.
Enables optimization but not blocking for core functionality.
Growth lever but low immediate impact; can be deferred.

recommended_next_steps: Consolidate duplicate UI components (LuxeCard/LuxeButton) into the modern token-based system.
Migrate legacy theme usage (shared/theme.dart) to tokens.dart/AppTheme across all screens.
Standardize payment flow via a unified WalletService abstraction used by Booking and Store.
Extract authentication concerns (token storage, refresh) into a dedicated AuthRepository.
Create unified avatar component for use in Profile, Chat, Provider screens.
Define clear service boundaries in documentation for each unit (as started in this audit).
Establish data ownership matrix and appoint data stewards for each domain.
Plan for observability: Add structured logging and tracing to cross-unit flows.
Review and update threat model for Auth and Payments units.
Validate accessibility (WCAG AA) on all core screens using automated tools.
